claim: Hecker et al. profiled CD19+ B-cell and CD4+ T-cell transcriptomes before and after high-dose methylprednisolone therapy for MS relapse, providing cell-type-specific glucocorticoid-response context.
future_grounding_route: Use GSE255952/GSE-linked processed data as a future non-OpenGWAS route to test whether the V32 glucocorticoid signature captures B-cell and T-helper-cell methylprednisolone response.

project_finding_reference.finding_id: V22 scalar is immune-tone bounded, not steroid/composition artifact

project_use: Sharper V50 source record for cell-type-specific steroid transcriptome confounding in MS relapse therapy.
relationship_note: This source is especially relevant to V32 because it separates B-cell and T-helper-cell transcriptomes, but it remains a future grounding route until imported and rerun.

source.citation: Hecker M, Fitzner B, Koczan D, et al. Differential gene expression in B cells and T helper cells following high-dose glucocorticoid therapy for multiple sclerosis relapse. Biomedicine & Pharmacotherapy. 2024;175:116721.
source.label: Hecker 2024 methylprednisolone B-cell/T-helper-cell transcriptome

source_terms.license_or_terms_label: Publisher/PubMed metadata plus public GEO locator; metadata-only reuse in V50
source_terms.reuse_notes: V50 stores source metadata and locator only; do not import expression values without a separate future grounding task.

why_unverifiable: The project has not imported GSE255952 or evaluated the V32 steroid-confounder panel on the cell-type-specific data.
